The packet will list each as skipped every time. (a) accept, a follow-up spec …

jobsnearme pitfall #50 (10-10, FS-488): never test gates.mjs's runGates by injecting a list. A runner whose default is the real GATES runs every real gate (npm test included, so the suite recursively) on old code or after any regression that drops the parameter; one FS-488 red run did until it was killed. Test a one-entry runGate(entry, cwd) instead, which is simply undefined on old code.
